entries.61.1: एवम् thus, ब्रुवद्भिः as they spoke, ऋषिभिः to the sages, काकुत्स्थः Kakutstha, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke, मुनयः O sages, किम् what, कार्यम् is to be done, ब्रूत tell me, वः your, भयम् fear, तावत् for the present, अपैतु let it depart
entries.61.2: काकुत्स्थे when Kakutstha, तथा thus, ब्रुवति spoke, भार्गवः Bhargava, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke, नरेश्वर O lord of men, भयानाम् of the terrors, देशस्य च and of the land, यत् which, मूलम् is the root, शृणु hear
entries.61.3: राजन् O king, पूर्वम् formerly, कृतयुगे in the Krita age, सुमहाबलः of exceedingly great strength, लोलापुत्रः the son of Lola, ज्येष्ठः the eldest, मधुर्नाम Madhu by name, महासुरः a great asura, दैतेयः a daitya, अभवत् there was
entries.61.4: ब्रह्मण्यश्च devoted to brahmins, शरण्यश्च and a giver of refuge, बुद्ध्या in understanding, परिनिष्ठितः च and fully accomplished, परमोदारैः most noble, सुरैश्च and with the gods, तस्य his, अतुला unmatched, प्रीतिः friendship, अभवत् was
entries.61.5: सः that, मधुः Madhu, वीर्यसम्पन्नः endowed with valour, धर्मे in dharma, सुसमाहितः च and well established, बहुवर्षसहस्राणि for many thousands of years, रुद्रप्रीत्या to win the favour of Rudra, तपः austerity, अकरोत् performed
entries.61.6: रुद्रः Rudra, तस्मै toward him, प्रीतः pleased, अभवत् became, सः he, वरम् a boon, दातुम् to grant, ययौ च and went, बहुमानात् out of great regard, रुद्रेण by Rudra, तस्य to him, अद्भुतः a wondrous, वरः boon, दत्तः was given
entries.61.7: महात्मा the great-souled one, सुप्रीतः well pleased, शूलात् from his own trident, महावीर्यम् of great potency, महाप्रभम् of great splendour, शूलम् a trident, विनिष्कृष्य having drawn forth, ददौ gave it, एतत् this, वाक्यं च and word, उवाच ह spoke
entries.61.8: त्वया by you, अयम् this, अतुलः unmatched, मत्प्रसादकरः winning my favour, धर्मः righteous practice, कृतः has been performed, परमया with the utmost, प्रीत्या affection, युक्तः filled, उत्तमम् this excellent, आयुधम् weapon, ददामि I give
entries.61.9: महासुर O great asura, यावत् so long as, सुरैश्च with the gods, विप्रैश्च and with the brahmins, न विरुध्येः you do not fall out, तावत् so long, तव your, इदम् this, शूलम् trident, स्यात् shall remain, अन्यथा otherwise, नाशम् to destruction, एप्यति it will go
entries.61.10: यः who, विगतज्वरः without misgiving, युद्धाय for battle, त्वाम् you, अभियुञ्जीत should challenge, तम् him, शूलः the trident, भस्मसात् to ashes, कृत्वा having reduced, पुनः again, ते your, करम् hand, एष्यति shall return to
entries.61.11: एवम् thus, रुद्रात् from Rudra, वरम् the boon, लब्ध्वा having obtained, महासुरः the great asura, भूयः एव once again, महादेवम् before Mahadeva, प्रणिपत्य having bowed, एतत् this, वाक्यम् word, उवाच ह spoke
entries.61.12: भगवन् O venerable one, देव O god, एतत् this, अनुत्तमम् unsurpassed, शूलम् trident, मम my, वंशस्य of the line, सततम् for ever, भवेत् तु may it remain, सुराणाम् of the gods, ईश्वरः हि the lord indeed, असि you are
entries.61.13: सर्वभूतपतिः lord of all beings, महातेजाः of great splendour, देवः the god, शिवः Shiva, तम् him, ब्रुवाणम् as he spoke, मधुम् Madhu, प्रत्युवाच replied, एतत् this, एवम् so, न भविष्यति shall not be
entries.61.14: मत्प्रसादकृता won by my favour, शुभा auspicious, ते your, वाणी word, विफला fruitless, मा भूत् let it not be, भवतः your, एकम् one, पुत्रम् तु son indeed, एतत् this, शूलम् trident, भजिष्यते shall serve
entries.61.15: यावत् so long as, अयम् this, शूलः trident, ते your, सुतस्य son's, करस्थः in the hand, भविष्यति shall be, शूलहस्तः trident in hand, सर्वभूतानाम् by all beings, अवध्यः unslayable, भविष्यति he shall be
entries.61.16: एवम् thus, मधुः Madhu, देवात् from the god, सुमहत् exceedingly great, अद्भुतम् wondrous, वरम् boon, लब्ध्वा having obtained, सः that, असुरश्रेष्ठः best of asuras, सुप्रभम् of fair splendour, भवनम् a mansion, कारयामास had built
entries.61.17: तस्य his, पत्नी wife, महाभागा the greatly blessed, प्रिया beloved, या who, कुम्भीनसी इति was called Kumbhinasi, महाप्रभा of great radiance, सा she, अनलायाम् upon Anala, विश्वावसोः of Vishvavasu, अपत्यम् हि was the child indeed
entries.61.18: तस्याः her, पुत्रः son, महावीर्यः of great might, दारुणः dreadful, लवणो नाम Lavana by name, दुष्टात्मा evil-souled, बाल्यात् प्रभृति from childhood onward, पापानि एव wicked deeds alone, समाचरत् practised
entries.61.19: दुर्विनीतम् ill-behaved, तं पुत्रम् तु that son, दृष्ट्वा having seen, क्रोधसमन्वितः filled with anger, सः that, मधुः Madhu, शोकम् grief, आपेदे fell into, एनम् to him, किञ्चित् anything, न च अब्रवीत् and said not
entries.61.20: सः he, इमम् this, लोकम् world, विहाय तु having quitted, वरुणालयम् the abode of Varuna, प्रविष्टः entered, लवणे upon Lavana, शूलम् the trident, निवेश्य having bestowed, तस्मै to him, वरम् the boon, न्यवेदयत् made known
entries.61.21: सः he, शूलस्य of the trident, प्रभावेण by the power, तथा likewise, आत्मनः of his own, दौरात्म्येन by the wickedness, त्रीन् the three, लोकान् worlds, विशेषेण च and above all, तापसान् the ascetics, सन्तापयति torments
entries.61.22: काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, एवंप्रभावः of such power, लवणः Lavana, तथाविधम् of such a kind, शूलं चैव and the trident, प्रमाणम् the measure of it, श्रुत्वा having heard, त्वम् हि you indeed, नः our, परमा supreme, गतिः are the refuge
entries.61.23: राम O Rama, वीर O hero, पुरा formerly, भयार्तैः afflicted with fear, ऋषिभिः by the sages, बहवः many, पार्थिवाः kings, अभयम् for safety, याचिताः were entreated, त्रातारम् a deliverer, न च विद्महे we found not
entries.61.24: तात good sir, ते वयम् we, सबलवाहनम् with his troops and mounts, रावणम् Ravana, हतम् slain, श्रुत्वा having heard, भुवि on earth, अन्यम् another, नराधिपम् ruler of men, त्रातारम् as deliverer, न विद्महे we know not, तत् therefore, लवणात् from Lavana, भयपीडितान् us tormented by fear, परित्रातुम् to deliver, इच्छामः we desire
entries.61.25: राम O Rama, इति thus, ते to you, भयजम् born of terror, कारणम् the cause, यत् च and what, उत्थितम् has arisen, निवेदितं तु has been made known, भवान् your honour, विनिवारयितुम् to avert it, क्षमः is able, अहीनविक्रम O you of undiminished valour, तम् that, कामम् desire, कुरु fulfil
entries.62.1: तथा so, उक्ते when it had been said, रामः Rama, कृताञ्जलिः with joined palms, तान् those, ऋषीन् sages, प्रत्युवाच answered, लवणः Lavana, किमाहारः what is his food, किमाचारः what his conduct, क्व च and where, वर्तते does he abide
entries.62.2: राघवस्य of Raghava, वचः the words, श्रुत्वा having heard, ते they, सर्वे एव all, ऋषयः the sages, ततः then, लवणः Lavana, यथा how, ववृधे grew great, निवेदयामासुः made known
entries.62.3: आहारः his food, सर्वसत्त्वानि is all living creatures, विशेषेण च and above all, तापसाः the ascetics, आचारः his conduct, नित्यम् ever, रौद्रता is savagery, वासः his dwelling, तथा likewise, मधुवने is in the Madhu wood
entries.62.4: सिंहव्याघ्रमृगद्विपान् lions and tigers and deer and elephants, बहुसहस्राणि many thousands, मानुषांश्चैव and men also, हत्वा having slain, नित्यम् daily, आह्निकम् for the day, आहारम् his meal, कुरुते makes
entries.62.5: ततः then, महाबलः the mighty one, संहारे when the dissolution, समनुप्राप्ते has come, व्यादितास्यः with gaping mouth, अन्तकः इव like Death, अन्तराणि whatever come between, सत्त्वानि creatures, खादते devours
entries.62.6: राघवः Raghava, तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, सः he, महामुनीन् to the great sages, वाक्यम् these words, उवाच spoke, तत् that, रक्षः rakshasa, घातयिष्यामि I shall have slain, वः your, भयम् हि fear indeed, अपगच्छतु let it depart
entries.62.7: उग्रतेजसाम् of fierce splendour, तेषाम् to those, मुनीनाम् sages, तथा so, प्रतिज्ञाय having given his promise, रघुनन्दनः the delight of the Raghus, सः he, सहितान् assembled, सर्वान् all, भ्रातॄन् his brothers, उवाच addressed
entries.62.8: महाबाहोः of the mighty-armed, भरतस्य Bharata, धीमतः of the wise, शत्रुघ्नस्य च and of Shatrughna, कः which, वीरः hero, लवणम् Lavana, हन्ता shall be the slayer, कस्य whose, अंशः portion, सः that, विधीयताम् let it be assigned
entries.62.9: राघवेण by Raghava, एवम् thus, उक्तः तु addressed, भरतः Bharata, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke, अहम् I, एनम् him, वधिष्यामि shall slay, सः that, मम my, अंशः portion, विधीयताम् let it be assigned
entries.62.10: भरतस्य of Bharata, धैर्यशौर्यसमन्वितम् full of firmness and heroism, वचः the word, श्रुत्वा having heard, लक्ष्मणावरजः the younger brother of Lakshmana, सौवर्णम् golden, आसनम् his seat, हित्वा having quitted, तस्थौ stood up
entries.62.11: शत्रुघ्नः तु and Shatrughna, नराधिपम् to the ruler of men, प्रणिपत्य having bowed, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke, महाबाहुः the mighty-armed, मध्यमः the middle brother, रघुनन्दनः delight of the Raghus, कृतकर्मा has done his part
entries.62.12: आर्येण by my noble brother, हि indeed, पुरा formerly, शून्या empty, अयोध्या तु Ayodhya, आर्यस्य of my noble brother, आगमनं प्रति for the returning, हृदये in his heart, सन्तापम् anguish, कृत्वा having borne, परिपालिता was guarded
entries.62.13: पार्थिव O king, इह here, बहूनि many, दुःखानि च sorrows, अनुभूतानि हि have indeed been endured, पुरा formerly, दुःखशय्यासु upon beds of misery, शयानः lying, नन्दिग्रामे at Nandigrama, अवसत् he dwelt
entries.62.14: फलमूलाशनः eating fruit and root, जटी wearing matted hair, तथा likewise, चीरधरः clad in bark, भूत्वा having become, ईदृशम् such, दुःखम् sorrow, अनुभूय having endured, एषः he, राघवनन्दनः the delight of the Raghavas, राजन् O king, मयि when I, प्रेष्ये as your servant, स्थिते stand ready, भूयः again, क्लेशम् hardship, न आप्नुयात् let him not meet with
entries.62.15: शत्रुघ्ने when Shatrughna, तथा thus, ब्रुवति spoke, राघवः Raghava, पुनः again, अब्रवीत् said, काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, एवम् so, भवतु let it be, मम my, शासनम् charge, क्रियताम् let it be carried out
entries.62.16: महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, मधोः of Madhu, शुभे in the fair, नगरे तु and city, त्वाम् you, राज्ये in the kingdom, अभिषेक्ष्यामि I shall consecrate, यदि if, अवेक्षसे you think it well, भरतम् Bharata, निवेशय settle there
entries.62.17: त्वम् you, शूरः are a hero, कृतविद्यश्च and accomplished in learning, निवेशने in the founding of a city, समर्थश्च and capable
entries.62.18: यः who, पार्थिवस्य of a king, क्षये at the fall, शत्रुम् the foe, समुत्पाट्य having uprooted, पुनः again, तत्र there, नृपम् a king, न विधत्ते does not appoint, सः he, नरकम् हि to hell indeed, गच्छति goes
entries.62.19: सः त्वम् you being such, मधुसुतम् the son of Madhu, पापनिश्चयम् set upon evil, लवणम् Lavana, हत्वा having slain, मे my, वाक्यम् word, यदि if, अवेक्षसे you regard, धर्मेण by righteousness, राज्यम् the kingdom, प्रशाधि rule
entries.62.20: शूर O hero, मम my, वाक्यान्तरे in reply, उत्तरं च any answer, न वक्तव्यम् must not be spoken, बालेन by the younger, पूर्वजस्य of the elder born, आज्ञा the command, कर्तव्या must be done, अत्र herein, न संशयः there is no doubt
entries.62.21: काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, मया by me, उद्यतम् made ready, वसिष्ठप्रमुखैः headed by Vasishtha, विप्रैः by the brahmins, विधिमन्त्रपुरस्कृतम् set forth with rite and mantra, अभिषेकं च the consecration, प्रतीच्छस्व accept
entries.63.1: रामेण by Rama, एवम् thus, उक्तः तु addressed, वीर्यसम्पन्नः endowed with valour, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, पराम् the utmost, व्रीडाम् abashment, उपागमत् came to, मन्दं मन्दम् very softly, उवाच ह spoke
entries.63.2: काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, नरेश्वर O lord of men, अस्मिन् in this, अर्थे matter, अधर्मम् unrighteousness, हि indeed, विद्म we perceive, ज्येष्ठेषु the elders, तिष्ठत्सु while they stand, कनीयान् the younger, कथम् how, अभिषिच्यते is he consecrated
entries.63.3: पुरुषर्षभ O bull among men, शासनम् your command, अवश्यम् without fail, करणीयं च must be carried out, महाभाग O greatly blessed one, तव your, चैव indeed, शासनम् command, दुरतिक्रमम् is hard to transgress
entries.63.4: वीर O hero, त्वत्तः from you, मया by me, श्रुतम् it has been heard, श्रुतिभ्यश्च and from the scriptures, मया by me, श्रुतम् it has been heard, मध्यमे when the middle brother, प्रतिजानति undertakes it, मया by me, उत्तरम् हि an answer indeed, न वाच्यम् must not be spoken
entries.63.5: दुर्वचः an ill word, घोरम् dreadful, व्याहृतम् has been uttered, मृधे in battle, लवणम् Lavana, हन्ता अस्मि I shall be the slayer, पुरुषर्षभ O bull among men, एवम् thus, दुरुक्तस्य of me who has spoken ill, मे my, दुर्गतिः is an evil course
entries.63.6: ज्येष्ठेन by the eldest, अभिहिते when a thing is enjoined, पुनः further, उत्तरम् an answer, न हि वक्तव्यम् must indeed not be spoken, अधर्मसहितं चैव and it is joined with unrighteousness, परलोकविवर्जितम् and shuts one out of the world beyond
entries.63.7: काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, सः अहम् I therefore, तव to you, द्वितीयम् a second, उत्तरम् answer, न वक्ष्यामि shall not speak, मानद O bestower of honour, द्वितीयेन by a second, दण्डः वै the rod of punishment indeed, मयि upon me, मा निपतेत् let it not fall
entries.63.8: राजन् O king, पुरुषर्षभ O bull among men, अहम् I, तव your, कामकारः हि doer of your will indeed, अस्मि am, काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus, मत्कृते on my account, अधर्मम् the unrighteousness, जहि put away
entries.63.9: शूरेण by the heroic, महात्मना great-souled, शत्रुघ्नेन by Shatrughna, एवम् thus, उक्ते when it had been said, रामः Rama, संहृष्टः well pleased, भरतम् to Bharata, तथा and likewise, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, उवाच said
entries.63.10: समाहिताः with attentive care, अभिषेकस्य for the consecration, सम्भारान् the requisites, आनयध्वम् bring, अद्य एव this very day, पुरुषव्याघ्रम् the tiger among men, राघवम् Raghava, अभिषेक्ष्यामि I shall consecrate
entries.63.11: ममाज्ञया at my command, काकुत्स्थम् Kakutstha, पुरोहितं च the family priest, नैगमान् the townsmen, ऋत्विजः तथा and likewise the officiating priests, मन्त्रिणः चैव and the counsellors too, तान् those, सर्वान् all, आनयध्वम् bring
entries.63.12: महारथाः the great chariot-warriors, राज्ञः of the king, शासनम् the command, आज्ञाय having received, तथा so, अकुर्वन् did, पुरोधसम् the family priest, पुरस्कृत्य having set foremost, अभिषेकसमारम्भम् the setting on foot of the consecration, राजानः the kings, ब्राह्मणाः तथा and likewise the brahmins, राजभवनम् the royal palace, प्रविष्टाः entered
entries.63.13: तथा so, महात्मनः of the great-souled, शत्रुघ्नस्य Shatrughna, अभिषेकः the consecration, ववृधे went forward, श्रीमान् splendid, राघवस्य of Raghava, पुरस्य च and of the city, सम्प्रहर्षकरः a cause of great rejoicing
entries.63.14: अभिषिक्तः तु and consecrated, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, आदित्यसन्निभः resembling the sun, बभौ shone, पुरा of old, सेन्द्रैः with Indra, मरुद्गणैः इव as by the hosts of Maruts, स्कन्दः Skanda, अभिषिक्तः was consecrated
entries.63.15: अक्लिष्टकर्मणा of untiring deeds, रामेण by Rama, शत्रुघ्ने when Shatrughna, अभिषिक्ते had been consecrated, पौराः the citizens, बहुश्रुताः deeply learned, ब्राह्मणाश्च and the brahmins, प्रमुदिताः rejoicing, आसन् were
entries.63.16: कौसल्या च Kausalya, सुमित्रा च and Sumitra, तथा likewise, केकयी Kaikeyi, याः च अन्याः and whatever other, राजयोषितः royal women there were, ताः they, राजभवने in the royal palace, मङ्गलम् the auspicious rites, चक्रुः performed
entries.63.17: यमुनातीरवासिनः dwellers on the bank of the Yamuna, महात्मानः great-souled, ऋषयश्च and the sages, शत्रुघ्नस्य of Shatrughna, अभिषेचनात् from the consecration, लवणम् Lavana, हतम् as already slain, आशंसुः looked for
entries.63.18: ततः then, राघवः Raghava, अभिषिक्तम् the consecrated, शत्रुघ्नम् Shatrughna, अङ्कम् upon his lap, आरोप्य having drawn, तस्य his, तेजः splendour, अभिपूरयन् filling to the full, मधुराम् a sweet, वाणीम् speech, उवाच spoke
entries.63.19: सौम्य O gentle one, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus, परपुरञ्जयः conqueror of the cities of foes, अयम् this, ते your, अमोघः unfailing, दिव्यः divine, शरः shaft, अनेन with it, लवणम् Lavana, हन्ता असि you shall slay
entries.63.20: काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, यदा when, महार्णवे upon the great ocean, शेते he lay, अयम् this, शरः shaft, सृष्टः was fashioned
entries.63.21: स्वयम्भूः the self-born, अजितः the unconquered, देवः god, यत् whom, सुरासुराः gods and asuras, न अपश्यन् beheld not, सर्वभूतानाम् to all beings, अदृश्यः invisible, तेन by him, अयं तु this indeed, शरोत्तमः best of shafts
entries.63.22: वीर O hero, विघाते in the work of destruction, वर्तमानयोः as they were engaged, दुरात्मनोः of the two evil-souled ones, मधुकैटभयोः Madhu and Kaitabha, विनाशार्थम् for the sake of destroying, त्रीन् the three, लोकान् worlds, स्रष्टुकामेन by him who wished to create, क्रोधाभिभूतेन overcome with wrath, सृष्टः it was fashioned, तौ च and those two, अनेन with it, युधि in battle, हतौ were slain
entries.63.23: जनभोगार्थम् for the enjoyment of mankind, अनेन with this, शरमुख्येन foremost of shafts, कैटभं तु Kaitabha, तथा likewise, मधुम् Madhu, तौ those two, हत्वा having slain, ततः then, सः he, लोकान् the worlds, चकार made
entries.63.24: शत्रुघ्न O Shatrughna, रावणस्य of Ravana, वधार्थिना by me who sought the slaying, अयम् this, शरः shaft, पूर्वम् formerly, मया by me, न मुक्तः was not loosed, भूतानाम् for living beings, महान् a great, त्रासः terror, भवेत् would arise, इति thus thinking
entries.63.25: महात्मना by the great-souled, त्र्यम्बकेण by the three-eyed one, शत्रुविनाशाय for the destruction of foes, मधोः to Madhu, यत् which, तस्य his, महत् great, शूलम् trident, उत्तमम् excellent, आयुधम् weapon, दत्तम् was given
entries.63.26: सः he, तम् that, भवने in his mansion, निक्षिप्य having set down, पुनः पुनः again and again, पूज्यमानम् worshipped, सर्वाः all, दिशः the quarters, समासाद्य having ranged over, उत्तमम् his choicest, आहारम् food, प्राप्नोति obtains
entries.63.27: यदा when, कश्चित् anyone, युद्धम् battle, आकाङ्क्षन् desiring, एनम् him, समाह्वयेत् should challenge, तदा then, रक्षः the rakshasa, शूलम् the trident, गृहीत्वा having taken up, तम् him, भस्म ashes, करोति हि does indeed make
entries.63.28: पुरुषशार्दूल O tiger among men, सः त्वम् you being such, आयुधविनाकृतम् parted from his weapon, तम् him, पूर्वम् before, अप्रविष्टम् he has entered it, पुरम् the city, धृतायुधः weapon in hand, द्वारि at the gate, तिष्ठ stand
entries.63.29: पुरुषर्षभ O bull among men, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, भवनम् his dwelling, अप्रविष्टं च and before he has entered, युद्धाय to battle, आह्वयेथाः you should challenge him, ततः then, राक्षसम् the rakshasa, हन्ता असि you shall slay
entries.63.30: अन्यथा otherwise, क्रियमाणे तु if it be done, सः he, अवध्यः unslayable, भविष्यति shall be, वीर O hero, यदि तु but if, एवम् thus, कृते it be done, विनाशम् destruction, उपयास्यति he shall come to
entries.63.31: ते to you, एतत् this, सर्वम् all, शूलस्य of the trident, विपर्ययः च and the turning aside, आख्यातम् has been told, श्रीमतः of the illustrious, शितिकण्ठस्य blue-throated one, कृत्यम् हि the work indeed, दुरतिक्रमम् is hard to overpass
entries.64.1: एवम् thus, काकुत्स्थम् to Kakutstha, उक्त्वा च having spoken, पुनः पुनः again and again, प्रशस्य च and having praised him, रघुनन्दनः the delight of the Raghus, पुनः एव once more, अपरम् a further, वाक्यम् word, उवाच spoke
entries.64.2: पुरुषर्षभ O bull among men, इमानि these, चत्वारि four, अश्वसहस्राणि thousands of horses, रथानाम् of chariots, द्वे two, सहस्रे च thousands, गजानाम् of elephants, उत्तमम् a choice, शतम् hundred
entries.64.3: अन्तरा among them, नानापण्योपशोभिताः bright with wares of every kind, पणवीथ्यश्च and rows of market stalls, तथैव likewise, नटनर्तकाः players and dancers, काकुत्स्थम् Kakutstha, अनुगच्छन्तु let them follow
entries.64.4: पुरुषर्षभ O bull among men, शत्रुघ्न O Shatrughna, हिरण्यस्य of silver, सुवर्णस्य of gold, नियुतम् a million, आदाय having taken, पर्याप्तधनवाहनः with wealth and conveyances in full measure, गच्छ go
entries.64.5: वीर O hero, नगेत्तम O best of the steadfast, सुभृतम् well maintained, हृष्टपुष्टम् glad and thriving, अनुद्धतम् not insolent, बलं च and the army, सम्भाषासम्प्रदानेन by kind speech and by giving, रञ्जयस्व win over
entries.64.6: राघव O Raghava, यत्र where, तिष्ठसि you stand, तत्र there, अर्थाः हि wealth indeed, न तिष्ठन्ति does not abide, न दाराः nor wives, न च बान्धवाः nor kinsmen, भृत्यवर्गश्च and the body of retainers, सुप्रीतः is well contented
entries.64.7: ततः then, हृष्टजनाकीर्णाम् thronged with joyful folk, महतीम् great, चमूम् army, प्रस्थाप्य having sent forward, त्वम् you, एक एव quite alone, धनुष्पाणिः bow in hand, मधुनः of Madhu, वनम् to the wood, गच्छ go
entries.64.8: मधोः of Madhu, पुत्रः the son, लवणः तु Lavana indeed, युद्धकाङ्क्षिणम् eager for battle, गच्छन्तम् as you go, त्वाम् you, यथा so that, न प्रजानाति may not know of, तथा so, अशङ्कितम् unsuspected, गच्छेः you should go
entries.64.9: पुरुषर्षभ O bull among men, तस्य his, अन्यः other, मृत्युः death, कश्चित् हि any at all, न अस्ति there is not, यः who, दर्शनम् within his sight, अभिगच्छेत् should come, सः he, लवणेन हि by Lavana indeed, वध्यः is to be slain
entries.64.10: सौम्य O gentle one, ग्रीष्मः the hot season, अपयाते when it has departed, वर्षारात्रे तु and the rainy season, उपागते has come on, त्वम् you, लवणम् Lavana, हन्याः should slay, सः हि that indeed, अस्य for this, दुर्मतेः evil-minded one, कालः is the hour
entries.64.11: तव your, सौनिकाः armed men, महर्षीन् the great sages, पुरस्कृत्य having set at their head, प्रयान्तु let them go forward, यथा so that, ग्रीष्मावशेषेण while the hot season yet remains, जाह्नवीजलम् the water of the Jahnavi, तरेयुः they may cross
entries.64.12: तत्र there, नदीतीरे on the bank of the river, सर्वम् all, बलम् the army, स्थाप्य having stationed, समाहितः composed, लघुविक्रमः swift of stride, त्वम् you, धनुषा सार्धम् along with your bow, अग्रतः ahead, गच्छ go
entries.64.13: रामेण by Rama, एवम् thus, उक्तः तु addressed, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, तान् those, महाबलान् mighty, सेनामुख्यान् commanders of the army, समानीय having assembled, ततः then, वाक्यम् these words, उवाच ह spoke
entries.64.14: वः for you, एते these, वासाः halting places, गणिताः have been reckoned, यत्र तत्र at each in turn, निवत्स्यथ you shall lodge, अविरोधेन without giving offence, स्थातव्यं च and you must halt, यथा so that, कस्यचित् to anyone, बाधा न no harm may come
entries.64.15: तथा so, तान् them, समाज्ञाप्य having instructed, महत् the great, बलं च army, प्रस्थाप्य च and having sent forward, कौसल्यां च Kausalya, सुमित्रां च and Sumitra, कैकेयीं च and Kaikeyi, अभ्यवादयत् he saluted
entries.64.16: शत्रुतापनः scorcher of foes, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, रामम् Rama, प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य having circled to the right, शिरसा with his head, अभिप्रणम्य च and having bowed low, रामेण by Rama, अभ्यनुज्ञातः च and given leave
entries.64.17: प्रयतात्मवान् of disciplined soul, महाबलः the mighty, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, कृताञ्जलिः with joined palms, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, भरतं चैव and Bharata, प्रणिपत्य having saluted, पुरोहितम् the family priest, वसिष्ठं च and Vasishtha, अथो then, प्रदक्षिणम् the rightward circling, कृत्वा having made, निर्जगाम went forth
entries.64.18: अथ then, सः he, तदा then, गजेन्द्रवाजिप्रवरौघसङ्कुलाम् thronged with floods of lordly elephants and choice horses, सेनाम् the army, अग्रतः ahead, प्रस्थाप्य having sent, मासम् तु for a month, नरेन्द्रपार्श्वतः at the side of the lord of men, उपास waited, अथ then, रघुवंशवर्धनः increaser of the line of Raghu, प्रयातः set forth
entries.65.1: सर्वम् the whole, बलम् army, प्रस्थाप्य च having sent forward, पथि on the road, मासमात्रम् a full month, उषितः having stayed, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, तदा then, एक एव quite alone, आशु swiftly, त्वरितम् in haste, जगाम went
entries.65.2: शूरः the hero, राघवनन्दनः delight of the Raghavas, अन्तरे on the way, द्विरात्रम् two nights, उष्य having lodged, वाल्मीकेः of Valmiki, पुण्यम् holy, उत्तमम् excellent, वासम् a lodging, आश्रमम् the hermitage, अगच्छत् reached
entries.65.3: सः he, महात्मानम् the great-souled, मुनिसत्तमम् best of sages, वाल्मीकिम् Valmiki, अभिवाद्य having saluted, अथो then, कृताञ्जलिः with joined palms, भूत्वा having become, एतत् this, वाक्यम् word, उवाच ह spoke
entries.65.4: भगवन् O venerable one, गुरोः of my elder, कृत्यात् upon his business, इह here, आगतः having come, वस्तुम् to lodge, इच्छामि I desire, श्वः tomorrow, प्रभाते at dawn, प्रतीचीम् the western, वारुणीम् of Varuna, दिशम् quarter, गमिष्यामि I shall go to
entries.65.5: मुनिपुङ्गवः the bull among sages, शत्रुघ्नस्य of Shatrughna, वचः the word, श्रुत्वा having heard, प्रहस्य smiling, महात्मानम् to the great-souled one, प्रत्युवाच replied, महायशः O greatly renowned one, ते to you, स्वागतम् welcome
entries.65.6: सौम्य O gentle one, इदम् this, राघवाणाम् of the Raghavas, कुलस्य हि of the line indeed, स्वम् is your own, आश्रमम् hermitage, आसनम् a seat, पाद्यम् water for the feet, अर्घ्यं च and the guest-offering, निर्विशङ्कः without misgiving, मे from me, प्रतीच्छ accept
entries.65.7: तदा then, काकुत्स्थः Kakutstha, पूजाम् the honours, फलमूलं च and the fruit and root, भोजनम् for food, प्रतिगृह्य having received, भक्षयामास ate, परमाम् the utmost, तृप्तिं च and satisfaction, गतः attained
entries.65.8: सः he, फलमूलं च the fruit and root, भुक्त्वा having eaten, तम् that, महर्षिम् great sage, उवाच ह said, आश्रमसमीपतः near the hermitage, इयम् this, ते your, यज्ञविभूतिः splendour of a sacrifice, कस्य whose is it
entries.65.9: वाल्मीकिः Valmiki, तस्य his, तत् that, भाषितम् speech, श्रुत्वा having heard, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke, शत्रुघ्न O Shatrughna, पुरा of old, इदम् this, यस्य whose, आयतनम् sacrificial ground, बभूव was, शृणु hear
entries.65.10: युष्माकम् your, पूर्वकः ancestor, राजा king, सौदासः Saudasa, तस्य his, भूपतेः of that lord of the earth, पुत्रः son, वीरसहो नाम Virasaha by name, वीर्यवान् valorous, अतिधार्मिकः exceedingly righteous
entries.65.11: सः that, सौदासः Saudasa, बाल एव while yet a boy, मृगयाम् the chase, उपचक्रमे set about, सः that, शूरः hero, चञ्चूर्यमाणम् roaming about, राक्षसद्वयम् a pair of rakshasas, ददृशे saw
entries.65.12: शार्दूलरूपिणौ in the shape of tigers, घोरौ dreadful, बहुसहस्रशः by many thousands, मृगान् deer, भक्षमाणौ devouring, असन्तुष्टौ unsated, पर्याप्तिम् their fill, न एव जग्मतुः they never attained
entries.65.13: सः तु and he, तौ those two, राक्षसौ rakshasas, दृष्ट्वा having seen, वनम् the forest, निर्मृगं च and emptied of deer, कृतम् made, महता by great, क्रोधेन wrath, आविष्टः possessed, महेषुणा with a great shaft, एकम् one of them, जघान slew
entries.65.14: पुरुषर्षभः the bull among men, सौदासः Saudasa, तम् that, एकं तु one indeed, विनिपात्य having struck down, विज्वरः free of care, विगतामर्षः his anger gone, हतम् the slain, रक्षः हि rakshasa indeed, उदैक्षत gazed upon
entries.65.15: तस्य his, रक्षसः of that rakshasa, सहायम् the companion, निरीक्षमाणम् gazing on, तम् him, दृष्ट्वा having seen, घोरम् dreadful, सन्तापम् torment, अकरोत् wrought, सौदासम् to Saudasa, इदं च and this, अब्रवीत् said
entries.65.16: यस्मात् since, त्वम् you, अनपराधम् guiltless, मम my, सहायम् companion, जघ्निवान् have slain, तस्मात् therefore, पापिष्ठ O most wicked one, तव अपि upon you too, प्रतिक्रियाम् requital, प्रदास्यामि I shall visit
entries.65.17: एवम् thus, उक्त्वा तु having spoken, तत् that, राक्षः rakshasa, तत्र एव there and then, अन्तरधीयत vanished, कालपर्याययोगेन with the turning of time, राजा the king, मित्रसहः Mitrasaha, अभवत् became
entries.65.18: राजा अपि the king too, अस्य of this, आश्रमसमीपतः near the hermitage, यज्ञम् a sacrifice, यजते performed, महायज्ञम् the great sacrifice, अश्वमेधम् the horse-sacrifice, तम् that, वसिष्ठः Vasishtha, अभ्यपालयत् conducted
entries.65.19: तत्र there, महान् a great, यज्ञः sacrifice, बहुवर्षगणायुतः lasting many groups of years, आसीत् was, परया with the highest, लक्ष्म्या splendour, समृद्धः abounding, देवयज्ञसमः equal to a sacrifice of the gods, अभवत् it became
entries.65.20: अथ then, यज्ञस्य of the sacrifice, अवसाने at the close, पूर्ववैरम् the old enmity, अनुस्मरन् calling to mind, वसिष्ठरूपी in the shape of Vasishtha, राक्षसः the rakshasa, राजानम् to the king, इति thus, होवाच spoke
entries.65.21: अस्य of this, यज्ञस्य sacrifice, अन्तः the end, जातः has come, मम my, भोजनम् food, सामिषम् with flesh, इह here, शीघ्रं वै right quickly, दीयताम् let it be given, अत्र herein, विचारणा deliberation, न कार्या is not to be made
entries.65.22: ब्रह्मरूपिणा in the form of a brahmin, रक्षसा by the rakshasa, व्याहृतम् uttered, तत् that, वाक्यम् word, श्रुत्वा having heard, पृथिवीपतिः the lord of the earth, भक्ष्यसंस्कारकुशलम् to him skilled in the dressing of food, उवाच said
entries.65.23: सामिषम् with flesh, स्वादु savoury, हविष्यम् fit for oblation, भोजनम् food, यथा so that, भवति it may be, तथा so, शीघ्रं वै right quickly, कुरुष्व make it, यथा so that, गुरुः the preceptor, परितुष्येत् may be well pleased
entries.65.24: पार्थिवेन्द्रस्य of the lord of kings, शासनात् by the command, सूदः the cook, सम्भ्रान्तमानसः his mind in confusion, सः that, राक्षसः rakshasa, पुनः again, तत्र there, सूदवेषम् the guise of a cook, अथ then, अकरोत् assumed
entries.65.25: सः he, अथो then, मानुषम् human, मांसम् flesh, पार्थिवाय to the king, न्यवेदयत् presented, इदम् this, स्वादु savoury, हविष्यं च and fit for oblation, सामिषम् with flesh, अन्नम् food, आहृतम् has been brought
entries.65.26: नरव्याघ्र O tiger among men, सः he, रक्षसा by the rakshasa, हृतम् fetched, सामिषम् the flesh dish, भोजनम् as food, मदयन्त्या with Madayanti, पत्न्या सार्धम् together with his wife, वसिष्ठाय to Vasishtha, उपाहरत् offered
entries.65.27: विप्रः the brahmin, तत् that, आमिषम् flesh, मानुषम् to be human, भाजनम् the dish, गतम् had entered, ज्ञात्वा having known, महता by great, क्रोधेन wrath, आविष्टः possessed, व्याहर्तुम् to speak, उपचक्रमे began
entries.65.28: राजन् O king, यस्मात् since, त्वम् you, मम to me, एतत् this, भोजनम् food, दातुम् to give, इच्छसि desire, तस्मात् therefore, एतत् this, ते your, भोजनम् food, भविष्यति shall become, न संशयः there is no doubt
entries.65.29: ततः then, क्रुद्धः तु and enraged, सौदासः Saudasa, पाणिना in his hand, तोयम् water, जग्राह took, वसिष्ठम् Vasishtha, शप्तुम् to curse, आरेभे began, भार्या his wife, एनम् him, अवारयत् च and restrained
entries.65.30: राजन् O king, यतः since, भगवान् the venerable, ऋषिः sage, वसिष्ठः Vasishtha, अस्माकम् our, प्रभुः is the lord, त्वम् you, देवतुल्यम् godlike, पुरोधसम् the family priest, प्रतिशप्तुम् to curse in return, न शक्तः are not able
entries.65.31: ततः then, धर्मात्मा the righteous one, तेजोबलसमन्वितम् charged with fiery power, क्रोधमयम् born of his wrath, तोयम् the water, व्यसर्जयत let fall, ततः thereupon, पादौ his own feet, सिषेच च and it drenched
entries.65.32: तेन by that, तदा then, अस्य his, राज्ञः the king's, तौ those, पादौ feet, कल्माषताम् a mottled hue, गतौ took on, तदाप्रभृति from that time onward, असौ that, सुमहायशाः of exceedingly great renown, राजा king, सौदासः Saudasa, कल्माषपादः Kalmashapada, संवृत्तः became, तथा so, नृपः the king, ख्यातः चैव and was known
entries.65.33: सः that, राजा king, पत्न्या सह along with his wife, वै indeed, मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, प्रणिपत्य having bowed low, ब्रह्मरूपिणा by him in brahmin form, यत् what, उक्तम् had been said, वसिष्ठम् to Vasishtha, पुनः again, प्रोवाच declared
entries.65.34: वसिष्ठः Vasishtha, पार्थिवेन्द्रस्य of the lord of kings, तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, रक्षसा by the rakshasa, विकृतं च and the deception wrought, पुनः again, पुरुषर्षभम् the bull among men, राजानम् to the king, प्रोवाच said
entries.65.35: रोषपरीतेन overcome with wrath, मया by me, यत् which, इदम् this, वचः word, व्याहृतम् has been uttered, एतत् this, वृथा void, कर्तुम् to make, न शक्यम् is not possible, ते to you, वरं च and a boon, प्रदास्यामि I shall grant
entries.65.36: राजेन्द्र O lord of kings, कालः the term, द्वादश twelve, वर्षाणि years, शापस्य of the curse, अन्तः the end, भविष्यति shall come, मत्प्रसादात् च and by my favour, व्यतीतम् what has passed, न स्मरिष्यसि you shall not remember
entries.65.37: एवम् thus, अरिसूदनः the slayer of foes, सः that, राजा king, तम् that, शापम् curse, उपभुज्य having lived through, पुनः again, राज्यम् the kingdom, प्रतिलेभे regained, प्रजाश्चैव and the people too, अन्वपालयत् he protected
entries.65.38: राघव O Raghava, यत् what, माम् me, पृच्छसि you ask, तस्य his, कल्माषपादस्य of Kalmashapada, यज्ञस्य of the sacrifice, शुभम् the auspicious, आयतनम् ground, अस्य of this, आश्रमस्य hermitage, समीपे is in the neighbourhood
entries.65.39: तस्य his, पार्थिवेन्द्रस्य of that lord of kings, ताम् that, सुदारुणाम् most terrible, कथाम् tale, श्रुत्वा having heard, महर्षिम् the great sage, अभिवाद्य च and having saluted, पर्णशालायाम् into the leaf-hut, विवेश he entered
